verdict.rationale: Langfuse's docs describe managed LLM-as-a-judge evaluators that automatically score live production traces. Users set them up with an evaluator and a rule, can run them on a sample of traffic, and get numeric, categorical, or boolean scores. Engineering guides apply the same evaluators to hallucination detection and RAG faithfulness. A community note says the feature may not be available in the free self-hosted version, which is a deployment caveat rather than a contradiction of the capability. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of judge configuration (custom prompt templates, judge model selection, variable mapping), independent hands-on corroboration of the evaluators in use.
